name: Think in Two
storyline:
You're Eren, a young adventurer with a strong will to save your brother.
However, when a mysterious ghost assumes his body, your search quickly becomes a supernatural pursuit.
You now need to find hidden hints, outwit the spirit, and explore a world where every shadow conceals a secret.
All to save your brother's life before the ghost fully takes over.
summary: Get ready for a puzzle 2D video game that will dazzle your eyes and challenge your mind! In this game, in this game you can Clone your self to explore new possibilities! But that’s not all! You’ll be amazed by how this simple mechanic transforms into something bigger and better with every level!
